title: How much is a knight-rider worth?
summary: Short explainer on the Knightrider fairy piece: it repeats the knight's L-leap any number of times in a straight line of L-steps. Shown on a 4x4 diagram, an 8x8 board and a 3D infinite plane.
rules: Knightrider: repeats the same knight vector (e.g. +1,+2) any number of times until blocked; stops on/captures the first occupied square.
